metrics.metric: Year-over-year growth in non-GAAP pre-tax profits
metrics.evidence: the Compensation Committee selected year-over-year growth in our non-GAAP pre-tax profits as the financial performance metric for determining our NEOs' annual cash bonuses for fiscal 2016

metrics.metric: Hardware products profitability growth (hardware revenues growth relative to hardware products development expense growth)
metrics.evidence: Mr. Fowler's target cash bonus opportunity was based on a percentage of the amount by which hardware revenues growth between fiscal 2015 and fiscal 2016 exceeded the expense growth

metrics.metric: Relative growth in total consolidated revenues (U.S. GAAP) versus PSU Comparator Companies
metrics.evidence: 50% of the number of target PSUs is tied to relative growth in total consolidated revenues measured on a U.S. GAAP basis

metrics.metric: Relative growth in total consolidated net cash flows from operating activities (U.S. GAAP) versus PSU Comparator Companies
metrics.evidence: 50% of the number of target PSUs is tied to relative growth in total consolidated net cash flows from operating activities measured on a U.S. GAAP basis

metrics.metric: Year-over-year growth in Oracle total revenues for Cloud SaaS and PaaS offerings (U.S. GAAP)
metrics.evidence: Mr. Kurian's 2016 PSUs are to be earned based on year-over-year growth in Oracle's total revenues for its cloud SaaS and PaaS offerings measured on a U.S. GAAP basis

metrics.metric: Year-over-year growth in Oracle Engineered Systems and storage products revenues (U.S. GAAP)
metrics.evidence: Mr. Fowler's 2016 PSUs are to be earned based on year-over-year growth in Oracle's total revenues for its Oracle Engineered Systems and storage products measured on a U.S. GAAP basis
